exposure: Infants with BPD were characterized as EUGR or non-EUGR at 36 weeks gestation or discharge
outcome: Risk factors of EUGR in very preterm infants with BPD
cohort: 1010 infants with BPD who were born less than 32 weeks gestation from 7 regions of China
finding: In very preterm infants with BPD, the lower the birthweight or the more severe the BPD, the greater the risk of EUGR.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was found to be an independent risk factor for extrauterine growth restriction in very preterm infants with bronchopulmonary dysplasia.
birth_weight: All infants were non-small for gestational age at birth, further stratified into < 1000, 1000-1499, and ≥ 1500 g
